newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK STOCKS UP 0.70 PCT AT 1230 LOCAL (0930GMT).
newsitem.headline: GREEK STOCKS UP 0.70 PCT AT 1230 LOCAL (0930GMT).

text.p: The Athens bourse's general share index was up 0.70 percent or 10.50 points at 1,504.03 from Thursday's 1,493.53 at 1230 local (0930 GMT).
Banks and industrials were trading 0.77 and 0.93 percent higher, respectively.
A technical problem with the Athens stock exchnage feed has interrupted price and trading information. The problem is being worked on. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
